title: Zero in the limit target is detected at a finite stage
statement: With [def-sbc-canonical-base-change-stalk-transitions], suppose S is affine and D:I→Over T is a small cofiltered diagram of qcqs schemes with affine transitions. Let c be a cone whose underlying scheme cone is limiting. For i∈I and any ζ∈B(D_i) with r_(c.π_i)(ζ)=0, there exist j and f:j→i such that r_(D(f))(ζ)=0. No source image, original element, or survival hypothesis occurs.

source.place: Tags 0F07 (restriction square and limit condition) and 09Z1 (higher direct image continuity)

proof.text: Apply the geometric base-change lemma with B=Over.pullback(pr_T:T×_S X→T), obtaining all affine-transition and qcqs hypotheses and the underlying scheme limit for B(c). Apply the natural target-stalk comparison to G=pr_T^*F; its isomorphisms identify every target stalk with the corresponding fixed-coefficient higher-image stalk and intertwine all projection and diagram transitions.

Transport ζ by E_i. Evaluate the projection-transition comparison on ζ; since hζ is zero and linear maps send zero to zero, the higher-image representative dies at the limit. Apply the second clause of higherDirectImage_limit to obtain j and f:j→i where its higher-image transition vanishes. Evaluate the comparison for D(f); E_j carries the desired target transition to zero. Injectivity of the isomorphism E_j proves that target transition is zero.

proof_origin.place: Tags 0F07 and 09Z1; geometric preparation proved in Lean and target natural comparison separated from zero detection

Existing higherDirectImage_limit supplies stalk continuity for higher images, but not source inverse-image/homology identification or target pullback/coefficient identification. Existing target composition and base-change naturality supply the two proved compatibility lemmas. No canonical stalk wrappers or source-image descent/target-zero detection declarations found.

lean.statement: theorem baseChange_target_limit_zero_detection (c : Cone D) (hc : IsLimit ((Over.forget T).mapCone c)) (i : I) (ζ : baseChangeTargetStalk Λ p g q F x (D.obj i)) (hζ : (baseChangeTargetStalkMap Λ p g q F x (c.π.app i)).hom ζ = 0) : ∃ (j : I) (f : j ⟶ i), (baseChangeTargetStalkMap Λ p g q F x (D.map f)).hom ζ = 0
